why: the dregs settled under the wine
the sitta that wedges nuts to break them
to shut about on every side
the element named only for itself
the sharp water drawn through ashes
living together to the good of both
the bad dream of the night
the small brown spots on the skin
a word with a stray mark and not a word
the milk bag of a beast
the osyris shrub named only for itself
the numenius with a long curved bill
the pyrrhula with a red breast
